summary: Tested new analytics requesters filter feature. Backend (11/11) PASSED. Frontend filter dropdown, fetch behavior, and Export-button label toggle work. CRITICAL bug found: 'All Profiles' default view renders empty rows because the new code uses fields that do not exist on /analytics/daily's top_requesters payload.

ui_bugs.issue: When requestersFilter === 'all' (default), each rendered row is empty (no name, email, or count badge). The mapping `r.requester_name / r.email / r.request_count / r.total_tips` does not match the /api/analytics?days=... payload, which returns `top_requesters: [{requester, count}]`. Net effect: 10 blank rows on first load, regressing the 'existing behavior preserved' contract.

action_items: Fix Most Active Requesters rendering for filter='all'. Recommended: keep one render shape and map analyticsData.top_requesters to {name: r.requester, email: '', request_count: r.count, total_tips: 0} OR update GET /api/analytics (daily) to include requester_name/email/request_count/total_tips on top_requesters. Frontend file: /app/frontend/src/App.js around lines 8447-8455.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: Backend /api/analytics/requesters correctly applies profile_id and event_id to MongoDB $match and excludes archived.

VERIFIED: Backend /api/analytics/export-requesters returns text/csv with filenames: requesters-YYYYMMDD.csv (no filter), requesters-profile-<first8>-YYYYMMDD.csv, requesters-event-<first8>-YYYYMMDD.csv. When both params provided, event takes precedence in filename (matches code's if/elif).

VERIFIED: Frontend filter dropdown [data-testid='requesters-filter-select'] has 'All Profiles' default + optgroup 'Profiles' (Default Test 2) + optgroup 'Events' (Sprint4 Event, Alex and Jenna Reception).
VERIFIED: Selecting a profile triggers GET /api/analytics/requesters?profile_id=<id>; selecting an event triggers GET /api/analytics/requesters?event_id=<id>.
VERIFIED: Export button label correctly toggles 'Export CSV' ↔ 'Export filtered list' based on requestersFilter.
VERIFIED: Clicking Export CSV while a filter is active calls /api/analytics/export-requesters with the correct profile_id= or event_id= query param, and the browser downloads the CSV.
BUG: 'All Profiles' (default) renders blank rows due to field-name mismatch (see ui_bugs).

Note: requestersData is unused in the 'all' branch; the field-shape divergence makes this code path fragile. Consider normalizing once in fetch (e.g., shape analyticsData.top_requesters on load) instead of inside JSX.

Note: server.py /analytics/export-requesters does not exclude archived requests, but /analytics/requesters does. Confirm intended behavior—exports may include archived rows while the on-screen list does not.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (filter dropdown, fetch on change, label toggle, filtered export all work; 'All Profiles' default rendering broken)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing data (1 profile: Default Test 2; 2 events: Sprint4 Event, Alex and Jenna Reception; 48 unique requesters under no-filter aggregation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend filter params are fully verified. Only outstanding issue is frontend rendering of analyticsData.top_requesters in 'All Profiles' view (field-name mismatch). Once fixed, re-run the playwright flow: login → Analytics tab → confirm rows show name + count in default state. Also verify /analytics/export-requesters archived-vs-non-archived consistency with /analytics/requesters if business intent requires it.
rca of the issue: The PR refactored the Most Active Requesters render to use a unified shape {name, email, request_count, total_tips}. requestersData (from /api/analytics/requesters) returns exactly those keys, but analyticsData.top_requesters (from /api/analytics?days=...) still returns [{requester, count}]. The frontend mapping `r.requester_name` / `r.email` / `r.request_count` / `r.total_tips` therefore resolves to undefined on every row in the default 'all' state. Reproduction: login as test@test.com → Analytics → look at Most Active Requesters card with 'All Profiles' selected → all 10 rows are empty. Mitigation: map analyticsData.top_requesters to {name: r.requester, email: '', request_count: r.count, total_tips: 0} in the 'all' branch, OR extend the /analytics daily payload to include the richer fields.
